Name: Kenneth's Mineral Loot Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a small addon for Kenneth's Grocery Store. It puts 53 vanilla minerals into Shop7, for when you just want the gem or crystal you need without relying on geode luck.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get is the full mineral set. Gems like emerald, aquamarine, ruby, amethyst, topaz, jade, diamond, and prismatic shard. Quartz, fire quartz, frozen tear, and earth crystal. Plus the whole geode mineral set, from celestine and marble to obsidian, fairy stone, and the rest of the collection. All vanilla items, no new sprites and no config.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Stock is unlimited, so you can buy one for the museum or a stack for gifts and crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Grocery Store installed, since this addon only adds items to its Shop7. It also needs Content Patcher to run.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install is the usual flow. Drop this folder into your Mods folder together with Kenneth's Grocery Store, then start the game. If Shop7 looks empty, check that the base Grocery Store mod is enabled first.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for players who want to finish the museum, stock up on gifts, or just skip the geode grind and buy the mineral they are looking for.[/b][/size]
